meta.name: Dark Bento Dashboard System
meta.purpose: Context for an AI coding assistant to replicate a dark, glassy, bento-grid clinical dashboard style consistently. Contains style rules only, no content from the reference screenshots.
meta.style_summary: Dark charcoal canvas, soft glass-like rounded panels, one high-energy lime accent, pill-shaped controls, circular arrow action buttons, smooth spline charts with horizontal gridlines only, generous spacing, large corner radii.

stack.styling: Tailwind CSS with CSS variables mapped from tokens below
stack.icons: lucide-react, stroke 1.75, rounded caps and joins
stack.data: TanStack Query for fetching and caching
stack.validation: zod schemas for every API response

risk_scale.note: Use text label plus icon with every risk color. Never rely on color alone.

typography.font_family: Urbanist, 'Plus Jakarta Sans', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif
rules: Table and list headers: 12px, secondary text, no uppercase.
Hover: background lightens one step, arrow buttons nudge 2px right.
Charts animate on first mount only.

shell.structure: Rounded app frame containing a fixed left sidebar and a scrollable bento main area.

sidebar.style: Floating panel inset from the viewport edges, vertical flow: brand at top, primary navigation, spacer, footer actions.

topbar.style: Sits inside the main panel, not full-bleed. Transparent over the frame.

main_grid.pattern: Bento: one wide primary panel, one chart panel beneath it, and an optional right rail of 340px for the focused item.

breakpoints.mobile: single column, sidebar becomes bottom sheet or drawer

layout.density: Comfortable. Row height 64px for list rows, 48px for compact rows.

states.active: Accent-colored icon and label, small accent dot on the left edge, no filled background.

pill_tabs.shape: Pill group inside a raised surface. Active tab sits on a lighter glass surface with primary text, inactive tabs use secondary text.

data_row.selected: Solid accent background, on_accent text, trailing circular button inverts to dark with accent arrow.
data_row.columns: Leading avatar or checkbox, primary text with secondary line beneath, then 2-4 aligned value columns, status chip, trailing action.

circle_action_button.aria: Always give an aria-label describing the destination.

pill_button.primary: Dark fill (#0A0A0B) with white text on accent surfaces, or accent fill with dark text on dark surfaces. Height 40, radius pill, padding 20 horizontally.
pill_button.secondary: Transparent with default border, primary text.
pill_button.ghost: No border, secondary text, hover surface.

panel_card.header: Optional leading 32px icon chip, title 16px, optional right-aligned dropdown or link with arrow.

accent_callout_card.contains: Short label, key fact in bold, supporting line, and one dark pill button.

chart_card.line: Smooth monotone curve, 2px stroke, no dots until hover.
chart_card.axes: No axis lines, labels 11-12px in axis_label color.
chart_card.legend: Small 8px colored dots with label, top-aligned to the title row.
chart_card.tooltip: Raised surface, radius 12, border default, 12px text.
chart_card.threshold_line: Dashed 1px line with a small label for clinical thresholds.

status_chip.shape: Pill, 24px tall, 12px text, leading 6px dot or icon.

stat_tile.layout: Label (12px secondary) above a large tabular number, optional delta chip.

list_rail.layout: Vertical timeline line with small dot markers on the left, rounded pill items to the right, each with avatar, two text lines, and a trailing arrow.
list_rail.use: Short ordered list beside a focused item.

avatar.fallback: Initials on surface_raised with primary text.

slider.use: What-if controls, always show the current value and unit.

empty_loading_error.loading: Skeleton blocks with the same radius as the content, slow shimmer.
empty_loading_error.empty: One-line message with a secondary text hint inside the panel.
empty_loading_error.error: Danger status chip and a retry ghost button inside the panel, never a full-page crash.

iconography.container: Optional 32px rounded-square chip with surface_raised background
iconography.color_rules: Muted by default, accent when active

navigation.rule: Include only the items below. Do not add messages, payments, calendars, settings or any other item unless the product owner asks.

sidebar_secondary.label: Model notes
sidebar_secondary.purpose: Static explanation of the data source, model, metrics and limits

topbar: signed-in doctor menu with Sign out
navigation.back_behavior: Patient detail has a back link to /patients, no extra tabs.

login.layout: Centered single panel_card on the app background, brand mark, username, password, one primary pill button.
login.states: Inline error text for wrong credentials, disabled button while submitting, generic error message that does not reveal which field was wrong.

patients.layout: Wide panel with data_row list sorted by risk descending, optional cohort stat tiles above, risk chip per row, trailing circle_action_button opening the twin.
patients.filters: Search by id and a risk filter in the pill tabs: All, High, Moderate, Low.

patient_twin.layout: Main column: glucose chart with the 2-hour forecast at 30, 60, 90, 120 minutes and the 180 mg/dL threshold line, signal panels for heart rate, steps and sleep. Right rail: record summary and the alert callout, then the what-if sliders for sleep and steps.
patient_twin.alert_rule: Show the alert callout when risk is at or above the backend alert threshold, otherwise show a calm neutral status.
patient_twin.what_if: Sliders for sleep and steps. Results are displayed only, never saved, and never suggest a drug dose.

model.layout: One or two panel_cards with text and stat tiles. Static copy: synthetic data notice, model description, held-out metrics, limits.

content_rules.always_visible_notice: Synthetic data, not clinically validated. Shown in the footer of every authenticated page, small secondary text.
content_rules.avatars: Initials only, since patients are synthetic.
content_rules.units: Always show units next to values, for example mg/dL, bpm, steps, hours.
content_rules.numbers: Use tabular numbers and consistent decimals. Show probabilities as percentages.

accessibility.contrast: Body text at least 4.5:1 on its surface. Dark text on the accent color passes.
accessibility.focus: Visible 2px accent focus ring on every interactive element.
accessibility.charts: Provide a text summary or table alternative for each chart.
accessibility.color: Pair every status color with a label or icon.

backend_integration.principle: The existing API at http://127.0.0.1:8000 is read-only context. The frontend adapts to it, never the reverse.
constraints: Do not edit any backend file, schema, route, model or data file.
Do not add CORS settings or middleware to the backend.
Do not guess endpoints. Read the backend source and write a typed client from what exists.
Validate every response with zod and show a panel-level error on mismatch.
Keep field names exactly as the API returns them. Map them to display names only in a UI layer.
backend_integration.pattern: Browser talks only to the Next.js server. Next.js route handlers under /api proxy to BACKEND_URL after checking the session cookie.

env.BACKEND_URL: http://127.0.0.1:8000 (server-side only, never prefixed with NEXT_PUBLIC)
env.DOCTOR_PASSWORD_HASH: bcrypt hash, never a plain password

backend_integration.polling: Refetch the open patient on a 30 minute cadence or on manual refresh, matching the model window. Use stale-while-revalidate.

authentication.scope: Doctor login only. There is no patient login and no demo mode or bypass.
authentication.where: Implemented entirely in the Next.js layer so the backend stays unchanged.
flow: POST /api/auth/login checks username and bcrypt hash from env, then sets a signed session cookie.
middleware.ts redirects any unauthenticated request to /login, except /login and /api/auth/login.
All /api/* proxy handlers reject requests without a valid session with 401.

session.cookie: httpOnly, SameSite=Lax, Secure in production, path /

hardening: Generic error text on failed login.
Append an access log line with doctor, patient id and time on every twin view, stored by the frontend server, not the backend.
Keep the backend bound to 127.0.0.1 so it is reachable only through the Next.js server.

do: Use one accent color only, and use it for the primary action, the active state and the selected row.
Use large radii and generous padding.
Keep charts quiet: horizontal grid only, thin smooth lines.
Use circular arrow buttons as the single pattern for opening an item.
dont: Do not use more than three chart colors in one chart.
Do not add decorative buttons, widgets or navigation not listed in navigation.
Do not use pure white backgrounds or hard drop shadows.
Do not mix corner radii within one panel.

ai_instructions: Read this file before writing any UI code.
Create CSS variables from tokens first, then build components that only use those variables.
Build shared primitives (PanelCard, DataRow, CircleActionButton, StatusChip, StatTile, GlucoseChart) before pages.
Match the structure and behavior described here, not any specific content.
When unsure, choose the simpler option and keep the navigation list unchanged.
